scripts.title: Slowburn Character System
scripts.description:
Ever feel like your AI characters have no middle ground? One minute they’re a polite stranger, and three turns later—after a single compliment—they’re professing their undying loyalty.

I wanted something more realistic, so I built Slowburn.

Slowburn is a lightweight scripting system for AI Dungeon designed to track NPC personality shifts on a 0–100 scale. It’s built for creators who want their characters to change gradually based on actual interactions, rather than flipping a switch.

scripts.description: Character Continuity(🧵): for NPCs who remember who they are—and who they’re becoming.

scripts.title: Character Continuity & Identity — Player Memory, Location & Presence
scripts.description: Keeps characters consistent across long AI Dungeon stories. Preserves the player’s chosen identity and appearance, remembers important NPC facts, tracks where characters actually are, prevents random teleporting and impossible overhearing, distinguishes permanent traits from temporary states, and respects established abilities and perception limits. Designed to work alongside Player Agency, Relationships, Time, Pregnancy, Health, Beastkin, and other reusable scripts without overwriting their state.

scripts.title: Autonomous and Realistic Combat
scripts.description:
Transform your AI Dungeon scenarios with a more **dynamic, dangerous, tactical, and believable combat system

**Autonomous and Realistic Combat** is designed to make fights feel less like turn-based exchanges and more like real, high-stakes battles where every character can think, react, adapt, fail, get injured, and die.

---

## 🧠 Smarter, More Autonomous Enemies

Enemies no longer stand around waiting for the player to act.

Combatants can:

- Attack first
- Dodge and evade
- Block and parry
- Counterattack
- Interrupt attacks
- Reposition
- Retreat or pursue
- Set traps
- Exploit terrain
